entries.text: The rubble has piled up high in the entrance way. It is too heavy to move. You wonder if the water chip might have once been there. If it was, it is no longer available.
entries.source_text:
The rubble has piled up high in the entrance way. It is too
 heavy to move. You wonder if the water chip might have once
 been there. If it was, it is no longer available.

entries.text: Big, heavy rocks are blocking the way to the room. You strain to move a rock, but it fails to budge.
entries.source_text:
Big, heavy rocks are blocking the way to the room. You
 strain to move a rock, but it fails to budge.
